answer: Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the sonnet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lotus re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
